title: 垃圾掩埋場複合襯墊~Composite liners for landfills
focus: 由地基、膜土接觸、焊縫與排水證據理解複合襯墊~Understand composite liners through foundation, membrane contact, seams and drainage evidence
summary: 本課以「由地基、膜土接觸、焊縫與排水證據理解複合襯墊」為主軸，依序處理地形與地下水邊界、膜材缺陷與水頭效應、鋪設面積與品質覆蓋、收集槽容量與停泵、降雨與上覆水量。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。~This course focuses on Understand composite liners through foundation, membrane contact, seams and drainage evidence, progressing through Terrain and groundwater boundary, Membrane defects and head, Laying area and quality coverage, Sump capacity during pump outage, Rainfall and overlying-water balance. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
history: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。~The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.

units.title: 地形與地下水邊界~Terrain and groundwater boundary
units.mechanism: 先將底部高程與地下水水頭分開，避免用地表坡向推定地下水流向。 水頭差除以距離給指定方向的梯度；單一剖面不能代替三維地下水流場。~Separate base elevation from groundwater head; surface slope does not determine subsurface flow direction. Head difference over spacing gives a directional gradient; one section cannot replace a three-dimensional groundwater field.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：兩點水頭 h1=12.4 m、h2=11.8 m；距離 L=30 m。公式 i=(h1-h2)/L，計算得 0.02 m/m。適用邊界：同一標高基準、同一含水層及同步讀值。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Heads h1=12.4 m, h2=11.8 m; spacing L=30 m. Formula i=(h1-h2)/L gives 0.02 m/m. Applicability: Common elevation datum, same aquifer and synchronized readings.
units.verify: 針對「地形與地下水邊界」，測井口標高並校正液位，將多井等水頭線與地層圖共同判讀。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Terrain and groundwater boundary, Survey reference elevations, correct water levels and interpret multiwell contours with stratigraphy. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 不同濾管深度或時間的液位可能產生假的水平梯度。 在「地形與地下水邊界」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Different screen depths or measurement times can create a false horizontal gradient. Mark where this error can enter the Terrain and groundwater boundary flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 任意兩口井的液位差都代表同一含水層的水平流向。~Any two well levels define horizontal flow in the same aquifer.
units.practice: 只將 h1 改成 12.7 m，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.02 變成 0.03 m/m。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only h1 to 12.7 m, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.02 to 0.03 m/m. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 低滲透土層原理~Low-permeability soil layer
units.mechanism: 壓實土層提供水力阻抗，但其現場完整性與試體性能需各有證據。 Darcy 定律將水力梯度與材料傳導係數連結到平均滲流；薄膜缺陷流不由這條均質式代表。~Compacted soil supplies hydraulic resistance, but field continuity and specimen performance require separate evidence. Darcy law links gradient and hydraulic conductivity to mean seepage; geomembrane defect flow is not represented by this homogeneous relation.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：水力傳導係數 K=1e-9 m/s；梯度 i=2；面積 A=1000 m²。公式 Q=K*i*A*86400，計算得 0.1728 m³/d。適用邊界：飽和、層流、均質材料；不含接縫孔洞、裂縫或非飽和行為。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Hydraulic conductivity K=1e-9 m/s; gradient i=2; area A=1000 m². Formula Q=K*i*A*86400 gives 0.1728 m³/d. Applicability: Saturated laminar flow in homogeneous material; seams, holes, cracks and unsaturated effects are excluded.
units.verify: 針對「低滲透土層原理」，核對試體飽和度、尺寸與水頭，再比較現場密實度及施工品質證據。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Low-permeability soil layer, Verify saturation, dimensions and head before comparing field density and construction quality records. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 試驗室低 K 不會排除現場接縫或穿刺形成的洩漏。 在「低滲透土層原理」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Low laboratory K does not rule out leakage through field seams or punctures. Mark where this error can enter the Low-permeability soil layer flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 只要材料 K 很低，任何施工缺陷都不會造成滲漏。~Very low material K prevents leakage regardless of construction defects.
units.practice: 只將 K 改成 2e-9 m/s，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.1728 變成 0.3456 m³/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only K to 2e-9 m/s, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.1728 to 0.3456 m³/d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 膜材缺陷與水頭效應~Membrane defects and head
units.mechanism: 使用理想孔口比較水頭效應，再辨認複合襯墊中膜土接觸使模型失效的地方。 自由孔口流量隨孔面積線性、隨水頭平方根變化；膜下土層接觸可顯著改變實際洩漏。~Compare head effects with an ideal orifice, then identify where membrane-soil contact invalidates that model. Free-orifice flow scales linearly with hole area and with square-root head; contact with underlying soil can greatly alter actual leakage.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：假想自由出流孔面積 a=1e-5 m²；水頭 h=0.30 m；流量係數 Cd=0.6。公式 Q=Cd*a*sqrt(2*g*h)*86400，計算得 1.25769 m³/d。適用邊界：只示範無背壓自由孔口，不能用來預測複合襯墊實際滲漏。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Hypothetical freely discharging hole a=1e-5 m²; head h=0.30 m; discharge coefficient Cd=0.6. Formula Q=Cd*a*sqrt(2*g*h)*86400 gives 1.25769 m³/d. Applicability: Only a free orifice without backpressure; not a prediction of leakage through a composite liner.
units.verify: 針對「膜材缺陷與水頭效應」，在紙上比較相同孔面積的兩種水頭，另列膜土接觸、缺陷形狀與土層 K 等缺失條件。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Membrane defects and head, Compare two heads for the same hole area on paper and list missing contact, geometry and underlying-soil conductivity conditions. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 忽略膜土緊密接觸或沿面流，會把簡化孔口式誤當成場址模型。 在「膜材缺陷與水頭效應」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Ignoring membrane-soil contact or interface flow turns a simplified orifice equation into a false site model. Mark where this error can enter the Membrane defects and head flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 複合襯墊每個孔洞的洩漏量都完全遵守無土層的自由孔口公式。~Every composite-liner hole leaks exactly as a free orifice without soil.
units.practice: 只將 h 改成 0.60 m，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1.25769 變成 1.77865 m³/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only head h to 0.60 m, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 1.25769 to 1.77865 m³/d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 焊縫試片與破壞位置~Seam specimens and failure location
units.mechanism: 同時觀察拉伸和剝離相關證據，焊縫外觀整齊不能替代機械性能。 名目拉應力由拉力除原始截面積；膜材與接縫失效還受剝離、蠕變及缺口影響。~Inspect evidence relevant to both tensile and peel behaviour; neat seam appearance does not establish mechanical performance. Nominal tensile stress is force over original area; membrane and seam failure also depend on peel, creep and notches.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：拉力 F=500 N；試條寬 w=0.025 m；厚度 t=0.002 m。公式 stress=F/(w*t)/1e6，計算得 10 MPa。適用邊界：均勻單軸名目應力，不是材料允許應力或接縫驗收標準。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Tensile force F=500 N; strip width w=0.025 m; thickness t=0.002 m. Formula stress=F/(w*t)/1e6 gives 10 MPa. Applicability: Uniform uniaxial nominal stress, not allowable stress or a seam acceptance criterion.
units.verify: 針對「焊縫試片與破壞位置」，記錄試片尺寸、載入速率與破壞位置，區分母材、焊縫和夾具滑移。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Seam specimens and failure location, Record specimen size, loading rate and failure location, distinguishing parent sheet, weld and grip slip. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只報最大拉力而不報尺寸，無法公平比較不同試片。 在「焊縫試片與破壞位置」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Maximum force without specimen dimensions cannot compare samples fairly. Mark where this error can enter the Seam specimens and failure location flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 拉斷力相同就表示不同寬度厚度的膜材強度完全相同。~Equal breaking force implies equal material strength for different strip dimensions.
units.practice: 只將 F 改成 600 N，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 10 變成 12 MPa。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only F to 600 N, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 10 to 12 MPa. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 鋪設面積與品質覆蓋~Laying area and quality coverage
units.mechanism: 把板片、接縫和穿越處編號，採樣圖需指出未檢區與特殊細部。 網格數需向上取整；空間覆蓋與熱點偵測機率是不同的採樣設計問題。~Identify panels, seams and penetrations; the inspection map must show untested regions and details. Grid counts round upward; spatial coverage and hotspot detection probability are different sampling-design questions.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：抽樣區域 A=10000 m²；每格面積 a=400 m²。公式 N=ceil(A/a)，計算得 25 sample cells。適用邊界：規則平面網格計數，未指定法規採樣密度或統計信賴。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Survey area A=10000 m²; grid-cell area a=400 m². Formula N=ceil(A/a) gives 25 sample cells. Applicability: Regular planar-grid counting, not a regulatory density or statistical confidence claim.
units.verify: 針對「鋪設面積與品質覆蓋」，將網格覆在地形與歷史活動圖上，保留障礙區與針對性樣本的理由。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Laying area and quality coverage, Overlay the grid on terrain and historical activities; document inaccessible cells and targeted samples. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 規則網格漏掉小型污染熱點，需與歷史與現場證據合併。 在「鋪設面積與品質覆蓋」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~A regular grid may miss small hotspots and must be combined with history and field evidence. Mark where this error can enter the Laying area and quality coverage flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 樣本平均值低就代表每個未採樣位置也都低。~A low sample mean proves every unsampled location is also low.
units.practice: 只將 a 改成 300 m²，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 25 變成 34 sample cells。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only cell area a to 300 m², holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 25 to 34 sample cells. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 排水坡向與局部窪地~Drainage grade and depressions
units.mechanism: 襯墊上積水增加水頭；設計坡向需在鋪設後以實測高程核對。 坡度影響重力排水方向；沉陷可改變原有坡向並產生積水。~Ponding above the liner increases head; verify installed grades by survey. Slope controls gravity-drainage direction; settlement can reverse grades and create ponding.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：落差 Δz=1.5 m；水平長度 L=50 m。公式 slope=dz/L*100，計算得 3 %。適用邊界：幾何坡度計算，不推定滑動穩定或排水容量。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Elevation drop Δz=1.5 m; horizontal run L=50 m. Formula slope=dz/L*100 gives 3 %. Applicability: Geometric slope only; slope stability and drainage capacity are not determined.
units.verify: 針對「排水坡向與局部窪地」，用固定基準點重測縱橫斷面，找出局部反坡而非只量兩端。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Drainage grade and depressions, Resurvey longitudinal and transverse sections against stable benchmarks to detect local reverse grades. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 端點高差正確仍可能在中間存在窪地。 在「排水坡向與局部窪地」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Correct endpoint elevations can still conceal a depression between them. Mark where this error can enter the Drainage grade and depressions flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 兩端坡度合格即可證明全段沒有積水區。~Acceptable endpoint slope proves there are no ponding zones along the route.
units.practice: 只將 Δz 改成 1.0 m，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 3 變成 2 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Δz to 1.0 m, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 3 to 2 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 收集槽容量與停泵~Sump capacity during pump outage
units.mechanism: 重播假想停泵並追蹤水位，將暫存容量和膜上水頭連結。 儲量變化等於流入減流出的時間積分；尖峰可能超過平均設計流量。~Replay a hypothetical pump outage and relate storage to head above the membrane. Storage change is the time integral of inflow minus outflow; peaks can exceed average design flow.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：流入 Qin=30 m³/h；排出 Qout=20 m³/h；持續 t=4 h。公式 dV=(Qin-Qout)*t，計算得 40 m³。適用邊界：固定流量時段與已知初始儲量，不含蒸發或滲漏。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Inflow Qin=30 m³/h; outflow Qout=20 m³/h; duration t=4 h. Formula dV=(Qin-Qout)*t gives 40 m³. Applicability: Constant flows over the interval and known initial storage; evaporation and leaks are omitted.
units.verify: 針對「收集槽容量與停泵」，比較液位曲線導出的儲量與泵流量積分，測試假想停泵事件的容量餘裕。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Sump capacity during pump outage, Compare level-derived storage with integrated pump flows and test capacity margin under a hypothetical pump outage. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只用日平均流量會忽略短時暴雨造成的積存。 在「收集槽容量與停泵」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Daily mean flow misses storage needed during short storm peaks. Mark where this error can enter the Sump capacity during pump outage flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 日平均流入小於日平均排出就保證任何時刻都不溢流。~Lower mean inflow than outflow guarantees no overflow at any time.
units.practice: 只將 Qin 改成 40 m³/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 40 變成 80 m³。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Qin to 40 m³/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 40 to 80 m³. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 集排水泵送需求~Collection-pump duty
units.mechanism: 排水需求與處理場接收能力連結，泵送功率不能代替防滲性能證明。 泵功率需包含靜揚程、摩擦和局部損失的總揚程；效率隨運轉點變動。~Connect drainage duty to downstream treatment capacity; pumping power is not proof of liner integrity. Pump duty uses total head including static lift, friction and local losses; efficiency varies with operating point.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：水量 Q=0.01 m³/s；總揚程 H=15 m；ρ=1000 kg/m³；g=9.81 m/s²；η=0.65。公式 P=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1000，計算得 2.26385 kW。適用邊界：清水密度與固定效率概念估算，不替代含固體泵選型或防爆設計。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Water flow Q=0.01 m³/s; total head H=15 m; ρ=1000 kg/m³; g=9.81 m/s²; η=0.65. Formula P=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1000 gives 2.26385 kW. Applicability: A water-density, fixed-efficiency estimate, not solids-pump selection or hazardous-area design.
units.verify: 針對「集排水泵送需求」，同時讀取液位、流量、壓力和電力，核對實際工作點。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Collection-pump duty, Read levels, flow, pressure and power together to verify the actual operating point. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 管道堵塞會提高阻力，固定額定功率不代表固定流量。 在「集排水泵送需求」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Pipe blockage raises resistance; a fixed motor rating does not imply fixed flow. Mark where this error can enter the Collection-pump duty flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 馬達額定功率相同的泵在任何管線都提供相同流量。~Pumps with the same motor rating deliver the same flow through any pipe system.
units.practice: 只將 H 改成 20 m，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.26385 變成 3.01846 kW。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only H to 20 m, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2.26385 to 3.01846 kW. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 降雨與上覆水量~Rainfall and overlying-water balance
units.mechanism: 分開未覆蓋施工期與運轉期降雨情境，避免同一逕流假設套用全部階段。 水量平衡以降雨扣除蒸散、逕流及儲量變化估剩餘向下通量。~Separate construction and operational rainfall scenarios rather than applying one runoff assumption throughout. A water balance estimates residual downward flux after evapotranspiration, runoff and storage change.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：面積 A=10000 m²；期間雨量 P=0.08 m；蒸散 ET=0.025 m；逕流 R=0.03 m；儲量增加 ΔS=0.005 m。公式 V=A*(P-ET-R-dS)，計算得 200 m³。適用邊界：同一時間窗與面積；每項均為教學輸入，不含橫向地下水。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Area A=10000 m²; rainfall P=0.08 m; evapotranspiration ET=0.025 m; runoff R=0.03 m; storage increase ΔS=0.005 m. Formula V=A*(P-ET-R-dS) gives 200 m³. Applicability: One time window and area; all terms are teaching inputs and lateral groundwater is excluded.
units.verify: 針對「降雨與上覆水量」，將雨量、量測排水與含水變化對齊，對未知項給區間而非強制零殘差。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Rainfall and overlying-water balance, Align rainfall, measured drainage and moisture change; bound unknown terms rather than forcing zero residual. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 忽略儲水變化會把短期蓄水誤認為永久減滲。 在「降雨與上覆水量」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Ignoring storage change mistakes short-term retention for permanent seepage reduction. Mark where this error can enter the Rainfall and overlying-water balance flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 沒有立即排水就代表所有降雨永遠不會下滲。~No immediate drainage means none of the rainfall will ever percolate.
units.practice: 只將 P 改成 0.10 m，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 200 變成 400 m³。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only P to 0.10 m, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 200 to 400 m³. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 施工品質證據交接~Construction-quality evidence handoff
units.mechanism: 將材料批號、焊縫試驗、修補位置與滲流監測串成可追溯紀錄。 獨立乘積量的相對方差近似相加；有共同校正來源時需加入共變異。~Link material batches, seam tests, repair locations and seepage monitoring into traceable records. Relative variances of independent product quantities approximately add; common calibration sources require covariance.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：獨立相對標準不確定度：流量 uQ=0.04、濃度 uC=0.06。公式 u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²)，計算得 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty。適用邊界：小誤差一階傳播與獨立性假設；標準不確定度不等於 95% 區間。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Independent relative standard uncertainties: flow uQ=0.04, concentration uC=0.06. Formula u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²) gives 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty. Applicability: Small-error first-order propagation and independence; standard uncertainty is not a 95% interval.
units.verify: 針對「施工品質證據交接」，建立每項不確定度來源表，將重複性、校正和代表性分開，檢查相關性。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Construction-quality evidence handoff, Build an uncertainty budget separating repeatability, calibration and representativeness; inspect correlations. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 增加同偏差的重複測量不能消除系統性誤差。 在「施工品質證據交接」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Repeating measurements with the same bias does not remove systematic error. Mark where this error can enter the Construction-quality evidence handoff flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 重複量測次數越多，所有系統性誤差都會自動消失。~More repeats automatically eliminate every systematic error.
units.practice: 只將 uC 改成 0.03，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072111 變成 0.05 relative standard uncertainty。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only uC to 0.03, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.072111 to 0.05 relative standard uncertainty. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
